name: How long does it typically take to install a new interior window sill?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install a new interior window sill?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to install a new interior window sill can vary depending on the window's size, the chosen material, and the complexity of the existing opening. A straightforward installation for a single window might take a few hours. However, custom cuts, repairs to the surrounding wall, or installing multiple sills in one visit will extend the duration. We can provide a more precise estimate after assessing your specific windows and the project scope during an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for an interior window sill varies by size, material, and opening complexity, typically ranging from a few hours for a single window to longer for multiple or custom jobs.
